notes.title: 🌟🎮 HEROES WANTED! Join the Revolution at a Special Discount! 🎮🌟

[b]Greetings, Heroes-in-the-making![/b]

Are you ready to embark on an epic quest filled with puzzles, strategy, and a dash of revolution? Look no further! As part of the BE A HERO event at Stuttgart ComicCon, we're calling all brave souls to join the vibrant and challenging world of Let’s! Revolution! 🌈✨

For a limited time, from December 9th to the 19th, gear up and prepare to chase down a cowardly King in a realm buzzing with adventure – at a heroic 25% OFF!

[b]Why Join the Revolution?[/b]

[b]🧩 Puzzle Meets Strategy: [/b]Dive into a roguelite puzzle mashup, where Minesweeper meets procedurally generated mazes.
[b]⚔️ Turn-Based Combat: [/b]Face off against quirky foes in strategic battles.
🎲 Accessible Yet Deep: Whether you're a puzzle pro or a newcomer, our board-game inspired gameplay offers depth and accessibility.
[b]🎨 Artistically Unique: [/b]Enjoy a world beautifully illustrated, brimming with satire and contemporary nods, crafted by our global team of artists.
[b]🎼 Eclectic Sounds: [/b]Get immersed with original music and sound design by Antfood, featuring international talents.

[b]Art and Revolution[/b] – In creating Let's! Revolution!, we at BUCK have harnessed the creativity of over 30 artists, most of whom had never worked on a game before. This isn't just a game; it's a canvas where art meets play, where each level is a stroke of genius from an underrepresented artist, bringing to life themes of unrest and resilience.

[b]Innovative Gameplay[/b] – We've turned the traditional dungeon crawler on its head! Blending casual appeal with tactical depth, Let's! Revolution! offers a fresh take on turn-based strategy with an inviting look and feel.

So, heroes, are you ready to take up the challenge? To laugh in the face of danger while untangling the puzzles of Beebom? Your adventure awaits!

Grab your cape, sharpen your wits, and let’s start the revolution – with style, strategy, and a whole lot of fun. See you in Beebom City!

notes.title: New Daily Challenge Game Mode! + Patch Notes v1.3.00
notes.content:
[h1]Daily Challenges[/h1]
This major update adds a new game mode, the Daily Challenge. Here are some details on how it works:

Once you've beaten at least one run at any difficulty you can access "Daily Challenge" from the main menu.

Each day of the week features one character class with a new set of 3 to 4 starting abilities. For any particular date, the class and abilities are the same for all players. 

The Daily Challenge is typically harder than the normal game since you start with fewer abilities. Can you win a Shadow run without Backstab? What about using the Oracle without Teleport? In our experience, it feels like playing at least 2 difficulty levels higher than the normal game. Figuring out how to finish the run while utilizing new abilities is part of the fun!

You can view and play up to a week of previous dates.
[list]
[*]Mondays: Trooper
[*]Tuesdays: Shadow
[*]Wednesdays: Oracle
[*]Thursdays: Charger
[*]Fridays: Hunter
[*]Saturdays: Witch
[*]Sundays: One randomized class of the six
[/list]
The game stores some stats of your Daily Challenge runs. If you beat a run on your very first try (without losing or abandoning the run) you will be awarded a "First Try Win" and a sparkle will appear next to the medal you earned in the Daily Challenge menu. The game also stores your "Win Streak" and "Total Wins".

All character classes and abilities are unlocked during the Daily Challenge regardless of your unlock progression in the main game. Playing the Daily Challenge will not earn green gems for unlocks.

[h1]Controller Vibration Added[/h1]
Vibration effects have been added when playing the game with a controller or on Steam Deck. If you prefer the game without them they can be turned off with Settings>General>Vibration.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug in which Throwing Knives restock cost at different upgrade levels was inconsistent (should always be 1 gold)
[*]Fixed Charger's portrait above the passives list being the Trooper's colors
[*]Fixed a bug where the Oracle or Witch could get trapped and have no moves available and not receive a Deus Ex Chovy Bubbleship Ticket
[*]Fixed bug in which the game would not save immediately after exiting Chovy's
[/list]

[b]From Antfood, the game's composer/sound design team...[/b]

The game's soundtrack takes players on an immersive adventure through the kingdom of Beebom, as they rise up against the despotic King.

Each region in this retro-futuristic sonic landscape has its own unique sound. Phlox swells with lively melodies and dynamic percussion propel a spirit of discovery and adventure, whereas Cymbidium's ancient woodlands echo with churning chord progressions and mesmerizing melodies. In the mystical lands of Saffron, dreamy chords, ethereal choirs and ritualistic percussion create a sense of enchantment. Upon reaching Beebom City, the bustling and carnivalesque capital trumpets an enchanting festive atmosphere but listen closely for a nod to the kingdom’s darker undertones.

Crafted across Antfood's 4 studios in New York, Amsterdam, Sao Paulo & Los Angeles, the masterful composition pays homage to 90s desktop game soundtracks, blending sample-based synths, acoustic percussion, and rich analog synthesis, creating a sonic tapestry that brings the game's concept, illustration, and gameplay to life.

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.2.04
notes.content:
Patch Notes v1.2.04
[list]
[*][b]Memory Optimization:[/b] In an effort to fix some of the crash reports we've been getting which we suspect are memory related, we decided to push a major refactor of how the game handles memory that we have had in the works. Pros: Much smaller overall install size + more performant game. Con: This required changing most of the binary of the application, meaning that this patch will require nearly a full redownload of the game if you already had it installed (~500 MB). From here on out, patches should be much smaller though!
[*]Added preloading animations to initial boot and choosing to "Continue" a saved run.
[*]Fixed bug in which the full pool of barks the King can give at the start of the boss battle were not included. There should be many more now.

[/list]
